items.alt: Rain drives festivalgoers toward a crowded Durga Puja pandal entrance in Kolkata as a volunteer tries to keep order, with the illuminated idol behind them.
Caricatures of Marco Rubio and S. Jaishankar meet by Mumbai’s waterfront while an empty chair and map evoke the skipped Delhi stop.
A tycoon atop a telecom tower rings a market bell as a long queue of investors climbs past rupee coins and rising arrows.
Protesters holding books and long receipts face police as flames rise from a French municipal building.
A Japanese sample-return probe gathers soil from cratered Phobos with Mars looming behind it and Earth in the distance.
Pope Leo XIV in white robes walks unaided toward a waiting car outside a hospital as doctors look on.
A caricature of Enzo Maresca conducts a sequence of seven match balls while Manchester City lead Ipswich 3–2 and climb six points clear.
